settings.heading: DESCRIPTION
settings.content: This high-quality ceramic cremation urn for human ashes is a modern, handcrafted tribute suitable for display in the home, garden, or columbarium. Finished in a rich speckled gray, this adult-size urn symbolizes strength, remembrance, and timeless love. Its simple yet refined design honors the dignity of a loved one’s life, offering a meaningful and enduring memorial after cremation.

settings.heading: CAPACITY & WEIGHT
settings.content: Up to 230 cubic inches. Ideal for a body weight of up to 230 lbs prior to cremation.

settings.heading: Is the texture of the speckled gray urn smooth or rough to the touch?
settings.row_content: Despite its stony appearance, the speckled gray finish is completely smooth to the touch. The speckle is an artisanal effect within the glaze itself, mimicking the natural variations of granite or river stone while maintaining a refined, non-porous surface that is easy to clean and gentle to hold.

settings.heading: How durable is the urn?
settings.row_content: All of our urns are fired at the same high temperature to ensure a non-porous, durable finish that will not fade over time.

settings.heading: What is the capacity of the large adult urn?
settings.row_content: All four color variations in our large collection have a consistent capacity of 230 cubic inches, suitable for an individual weighing up to 230 lbs prior to cremation.

settings.heading: How do I seal the lid on these ceramic urns?
settings.row_content: The lid can be permanently secured using a small amount of the supplied silicone adhesive applied to the lip of the urn opening.
